reference:
On Parole is the first recording made by the band Motörhead, and it was left unreleased at the time of its completion in 1976, and it was not released until over three years later, on 8 December 1979.

FINDING: Motörhead

corruptions.text:
PLAN: Identify English rock bands and find an unreleased recording that has remained unreleased for over three years.

**Finding:** Motörhead, formed in June 1975. Their first record "On Parole" was released almost four years after its completion in 1976.
